reviewNotes: HOLD. Current StarHub prepaid has a clear one-month plan plus 120-day grace/termination lifecycle, but passport-only registrations are limited to 30 days and must be re-registered with a Singapore-issued identity/work pass to continue. The legacy $10 top-up/old USSD keep-alive framing is stale under the current monthly Prepaid plans. Current community reports also preserve OTP-delay/reliability uncertainty.

events.outcome: Current StarHub Prepaid is a monthly-plan product with a 120-day post-expiry grace period. Passport-only prepaid registration is limited to 30 days unless re-registered using an eligible Singapore-issued identity/work pass; the legacy cheap-USSD/top-up retention model is withdrawn.

data.acquisitionSummary: Current StarHub Prepaid starts at SGD12/month and is sold through StarHub/authorised reseller channels. A passport can register prepaid only for 30 days; continued use requires re-registration with an eligible Singapore-issued identity/work pass. StarHub also sells a separate Tourist SIM/eSIM product, which is not treated as this long-term route.

keep.action: Current plan validity is one month. After expiry, StarHub provides a 120-day grace period during which incoming calls and SMS remain available; renew a current prepaid plan before that grace period ends. Do not convert this grace window into an unsupported exact annual keep cost.

data.chinaActivation: Initial registration is Singapore-based for the ordinary Prepaid route. China is listed among current APAC roaming destinations for relevant plans, but overseas-first ordinary Prepaid activation is not established.
data.kyc: Passport-only prepaid registration is valid for 30 days from registration. To continue beyond 30 days, StarHub terms require re-registration at a StarHub Shop with a valid Singapore-issued identity card/work pass. Current plan FAQ lists NRIC/ONE Pass/Employment Pass/S Pass/Work Permit/Student Pass/Dependent Pass/Long Term Visit Pass as ordinary eligibility examples.
data.payment: StarHub App/online top-up accepts Visa, Mastercard and China UnionPay. The old *123# USSD self-service path no longer works after the 3G shutdown.
data.roamingSms: Current prepaid plans include roaming and China is listed among supported APAC destinations. Community reports in 2026 preserve a real OTP-delay/reliability risk on the StarHub network; do not represent OTP delivery as guaranteed.
data.holdReason: Ordinary StarHub Prepaid now has a clear 1-month + 120-day grace lifecycle, but passport-only registration is limited to 30 days unless the line is re-registered with an eligible Singapore-issued identity/work pass. This blocks the typical nonresident long-term route, and 2026 community reports preserve OTP reliability uncertainty.
data.tariffSummary: Current Prepaid starts at SGD12/month; plan validity 1 month, then 120-day incoming-call/SMS grace. Passport-only registration is limited to 30 days unless re-registered with eligible Singapore ID/work pass.
guideSteps: Do not use the legacy $10/USSD validity-extension claim; current Prepaid is a monthly-plan product.
Treat the 120-day period as a grace/recovery window, not a passport-user entitlement to long-term service.
For passport-only users, require evidence of eligible Singapore re-registration before considering this a long-term route.
